title: Lelylijn employment accessibility: web display export

neighbourhoods.name: CBS neighbourhood name
neighbourhoods.baseline90: Estimated jobs reachable within90 minutes, baseline network
neighbourhoods.scenario90: Estimated jobs reachable within90 minutes, modelled Lelylijn network
neighbourhoods.gain90: scenario90 minus baseline90; additional reachable jobs, not jobs created
neighbourhoods.baseline: Five raw job counts ordered as thresholdsMinutes
neighbourhoods.scenario: Five raw job counts ordered as thresholdsMinutes
neighbourhoods.population: Fixed neighbourhood population used in dissertation
neighbourhoods.stationMinutes: Minimum baseline transit/walk travel_time_p50 to a modelled Lelylijn station; null where unavailable
neighbourhoods.f45: Primary evaluation population: eligible and baseline stationMinutes<=45
neighbourhoods.focused5: Eligible in five service-station COROP regions
neighbourhoods.eligible: Finite positive population and finite90 minute accessibility for both networks

sources.code: R/07_dissertation_figures.qmd: final Figures4.1/4.2 and canonical Table4.5 construction

transformations: Use original CBS-derived study neighbourhood geometry without additional polygon simplification; background from CBS neighbourhood union
Neighbourhood and context coordinates converted to WGS84 at 9 decimal places; route retains 25m simplification and 5-decimal coordinates
Preserve all existing feature property objects exactly, including accessibility arrays and flags
No routing, scenario, accessibility or summary results recalculated

display.gainScale: Use logarithmic or clearly labelled discrete bins for positive gains; zero gain neutral; missing values distinct
display.baselineScale: Use a shared scale for baseline and scenario; label logarithmic transformation if used
display.geometry: Original CBS-generalised study boundaries, with no additional per-polygon simplification. Coordinates use 9 decimal places. This remains administrative display geometry, not cadastral detail.
display.mapData: Map retains all5111 study geometries. Summary denominators use4912 eligible positive-population neighbourhoods; filters do not manufacture zeros for missing values.

caveats: Potential access to fixed estimated employment, not realised employment or economic-growth impact
F45 station access defines a population and is distinct from the30-120 minute job-accessibility budget
Modelled alignment is not a claim about an approved construction route
Neighbourhood raw job counts are rounded to nearest whole job in the dissertation's existing data
Old accessibility_pop.rds has different job values and is deliberately not used
Source geometry CBS2023; no individual-level or sensitive data included
